Human Checkpoint · durable service-request workflow
info: The dashboard asks for work. Node-RED persists state, delegates MoltNet tasks, and stops at the two YubiKey decisions.

name: Dashboard surfaces
info: The request queue, YubiKey setup, and technician workspace are FlowFuse Dashboard templates owned by this flow.

name: Authenticated dashboard API
info: One read route rebuilds authoritative state. One allowlisted mutation route advances the workflow.

name: 1 — Claim the assigned request
info: Node-RED binds the exact request and bounded preparation permissions. No history review or AI task starts before the technician signs the claim.

name: 2 — Prepare the technician brief
info: After the completed claim, MoltNet reviews approved history, performs the bounded public-source check, and prepares the immutable brief.

name: 3 — Lock the field note and request approval
info: The exact brief, field note, disposition, role, and shift become the second YubiKey signing request.

name: 4 — Verify approval and release the work order
info: Node-RED re-fetches the authoritative request and re-binds the exact approved bytes before closing the work order.

name: 5–6 — Build and verify portable evidence
info: The final record verifies offline. The same path demonstrates that a one-character field-note change fails.

name: Recovery path
info: Every node failure returns a safe actionable message to the originating dashboard request.
